page.seoTitle: AI Training for Employees at Small Businesses | Páramo
page.seoDescription: Hands-on AI training for employees at small businesses, built around the work your team actually does. On-site workshops in the Twin Cities, from 90 minutes to a full day.
page.eyebrow: What we do · Team AI Workshops
page.title: AI training for your whole team, on their real work.
page.lede: Hands-on sessions in plain language, built around the tasks your people actually do, so AI becomes part of the job instead of another login.

forWho.title: Who it is for
forWho.intro: Teams where a few people use AI well and most have not started, or started and stopped.
signs: Leadership wants the team using AI, but the team is not sure where it fits their job.
People have tried ChatGPT or Claude on their own, with mixed results.
You are rolling out a business AI plan and want people to actually use it.
You want everyone working from the same habits and the same rules.

items.name: An assessment first
items.body: We learn where your team’s hours go and where everyone stands with AI today, so the session fits your people.

items.name: A working session on site
items.body: 90 minutes, a half day or a full day, practiced on your own tools and simple builds, not generic demos.

items.name: Done-with-you hours
items.body: Time after the session, as a group or one on one, building the workflows your team asked for.

items.name: Material to keep
items.body: A prompt guide, a simple framework for writing good prompts, and first-week homework.

steps.title: Assess
steps.body: We sit with your team, learn where the hours go, and see where everyone stands with AI today.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: You get the findings, person by person: where your team’s hours go, what that time is worth, and what to build first.

steps.title: Learn
steps.body: A working session on site: 90 minutes, a half day or a full day. Your team gets fluent in Claude: projects, skills, artifacts and your own tools connected, practiced on simple builds.

steps.title: Build together
steps.body: Done-with-you hours, as a group or one on one, building the systems your team asked for so they actually get used.

steps.title: Keep going
steps.body: Everyone leaves with a prompt guide, a simple framework for writing good prompts, and first-week homework.

examples.title: What it looks like in practice
examples.intro: Workshops are measured: we survey the team before and after.

items.body: A paid hands-on Claude workshop for the account management team. Clarity on where AI could help rose from 2.3 to 4.2 out of 5, and confidence using it from 2.5 to 3.7.
About eight so far across five Twin Cities coworking spaces, with rooms of 5 to 30 people. The SafeRide Health workshop came out of one of them.

faq.q: Does our team need to be technical?
faq.a: No. Everything is in plain language and practiced on the work people already do.

faq.q: Which AI tools do you teach?
faq.a: Mostly Claude and ChatGPT on business plans, connected to the tools your team already uses. If you already pay for Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, we start there.

faq.q: Is it in person or remote?
faq.a: The working session is on site. Follow-up hours can be in person or remote.
The done-with-you hours turn what people learned into workflows they use every week. Some teams then add an AI Strategy or a fractional chief AI officer.
